WITH observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(os.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
  AVG(os.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(os.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM observatory_shares AS os
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE os.share > a.average_share;
